Bandits - the criminal element of the Zone. They control several territories on the Garbage. Most controlled points are not connected to each other, leading to a series of logistical problems. They lack proper weaponry and a substantial number of capable fighters. The faction must unite its squads on the location to successfully counter other groups.

Victory! A conflict was brewing within the faction. Squads on the Garbage held different principles than the main Bandit force and decided to form a separate faction with a convenient base in the Depot, where the Bandit faction's base once stood long ago. After Boar's death, the Bandits failed to establish centralized authority, so no one could stop the Garbage squads. But separating is one thing
column3: holding what you've taken is another. Peace was made with Loners and Duty, but a controlled location is too juicy a prize, and the ceasefire is unlikely to last long...
